individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial heatmap plots showing per-spot deconvolution values overlaid on tissue images; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Box plots of immune cell fractions have individual data points (dots) overlaid on top of the box plots for both T11b-high LUSC and LUAD groups.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values (a derived summary statistic from differential expression analysis across many spots, each annotated with a p-value), not a mean of a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable here.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so individual data points are not applicable.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - spatial heatmap plots do not contain error bars or box-plot elements.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; ... (minima=..., median=..., maxima=..., Q1=..., Q3=...)
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - the caption explicitly defines the box plot elements (25th-75th percentile box) and provides minima, maxima, median, Q1 and Q3 values for every group/parameter shown.
not needed - GSEA enrichment plots show a single enrichment score curve with no error bars.
not needed - the bar graph shows single log2 fold-change values with associated p-values and no visible error bars.
not needed - representative micrographs do not contain error bars.
